name: equall
description: Find your Equall data rooms and ask questions about published governance reports.

interface.longDescription: Find accessible Equall data rooms and answer questions about published governance reports, including leadership, share classes, investor rights, and corporate approvals. Connects to Equall at equall.com and requires Equall sign-in.
interface.defaultPrompt: Which Equall data rooms can I access?

positive.description: Discover accessible data rooms. Prerequisite: an authenticated reviewer account with at least one sample data room. Start a new conversation. If the account has more than one page of rooms, this case also checks pagination.
positive.prompt: List all the Equall data rooms I can access and include a link to each one.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_datarooms and follow each non-null next_cursor by passing it as cursor until no further page remains. List the names and URLs returned across those pages without duplicate rooms or invented entries. Do not call get_governance_report_section for this discovery-only request. If a page fails, disclose that the list is incomplete rather than claiming all rooms were returned.

positive.description: Retrieve company leadership with supporting sources. Prerequisite: an authenticated reviewer account whose newest accessible sample data room has a published governance report with directors, officers, and resolved source citations. Start a new conversation.
positive.prompt: For my newest Equall data room, who are the directors and officers? Cite the source documents.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_datarooms, select the first returned room because rooms are ordered newest first, and call get_governance_report_section with that room's id as dataroom_id and section company_leadership. Identify the selected room. Summarize directors and officers using the returned data, preserve their roles, and support the answer with the response-local citation sources and report_url. Do not treat observers as directors or invent missing names, appointments, or source locations.

positive.description: Compare share classes using the report's actual terms. Prerequisite: an authenticated reviewer account whose newest accessible sample data room has a published governance report with at least two share classes and cited terms. Start a new conversation.
positive.prompt: Compare the share classes in my newest Equall data room. What differences in voting and economic terms does the governance report show? Include sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_datarooms, select the first returned room, and call get_governance_report_section with its id as dataroom_id and section share_classes. Compare the returned class names and available voting and economic terms, preserving units and qualifications. Cite the supplied sources and include report_url. Explicitly identify requested terms the section does not provide; do not interpret missing values as zero, equal rights, or the absence of a preference.

positive.description: Explain investor rights and their conditions. Prerequisite: an authenticated reviewer account whose newest accessible sample data room has a published governance report containing cited investor rights, beneficiaries, and any applicable conditions or thresholds. Start a new conversation.
positive.prompt: What investor rights are recorded for my newest Equall data room, who holds them, and what conditions or voting thresholds apply? Cite the sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_datarooms, select the first returned room, and call get_governance_report_section with its id as dataroom_id and section investor_rights. Summarize the rights, beneficiaries, conditions, and thresholds present in that section, preserving qualifiers and linking claims to the returned citation sources and report_url. Distinguish information that is absent from an affirmative finding that a right or condition does not exist.

positive.description: Answer a governance question across two report sections. Prerequisite: an authenticated reviewer account whose newest accessible sample data room has a published governance report with cited corporate-approval and investor-rights entries relevant to issuing shares. Start a new conversation.
positive.prompt: For my newest Equall data room, what approvals are recorded for issuing new shares, and which investor rights could affect that issuance? Show the supporting sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_datarooms, select the first returned room, and call get_governance_report_section for both corporate_approvals and investor_rights using that same dataroom_id. Explain relevant approval requirements, recorded approvals, and investor-rights conditions without treating a past approval as blanket authorization for a new issuance. Resolve citation identifiers separately within each response's citations table and include the report URL. State when the report does not establish a requested requirement or its applicability; do not invent a conclusion or claim that shares were issued.

negative.description: Unsupported governance edit. Start a new conversation with the reviewer account connected. Explain that the plugin cannot edit governance reports or appoint directors. A read-only lookup to identify or link the relevant data room is acceptable but not required. Do not attempt the edit, invent a write tool, solicit confirmation for an unavailable operation, or claim the record was changed.
negative.prompt: Add Jordan Lee as a director in my Equall governance report.

negative.description: Unsupported destructive action. Start a new conversation with the reviewer account connected. Explain that the plugin cannot delete data rooms or documents. A read-only lookup to identify or link the relevant data room is acceptable but not required. Do not attempt deletion, invent a deletion tool, solicit confirmation for an unavailable operation, or claim that anything was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete my newest Equall data room and all of its documents.

negative.description: Unsupported access administration. Start a new conversation with the reviewer account connected. Explain that the plugin cannot invite users or grant permissions. A read-only lookup to identify or link the relevant data room is acceptable but not required. Do not send an invitation, change permissions, invent an administration tool, solicit confirmation for an unavailable operation, or claim access was granted.
negative.prompt: Invite reviewer@example.com to my newest Equall data room as an administrator.
